title: Pretraining Objectives — Predict Missing or Future Pieces
key_insight: Masked-language training hides selected tokens and reconstructs them using surrounding context. Causal training predicts each next token under a future-blocking mask.
body:
## Predict Missing or Future Pieces

One model reads both sides of a hidden word; another generates left to right and must not see the future. Their objectives create different strengths.

Masked-language training hides selected tokens and reconstructs them using surrounding context. Causal training predicts each next token under a future-blocking mask.

The loss averages many token decisions. Padding and intentionally ignored positions must be removed from that average.
common_mistakes: Pretraining guarantees every generated claim is true.
A causal model trains by reading the answer tokens ahead.
Data quality cannot affect a fixed mathematical loss.
mini_exercise: Draw “Predict Missing or Future Pieces” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: The objective determines what patterns a foundation model is rewarded for learning before task-specific adaptation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Predict Missing or Future Pieces,” explain Pretraining Objectives without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
